options.name: happy
options.what: Good spirits: things are going fine.

options.name: excited
options.not_for: Routine wins, however many.
options.what: Thrilled: something big went right, such as a turn of 10 minutes or more finishing clean.

options.name: proud
options.not_for: A routine finish, however long.
options.what: Something hard-won finished: a comeback, or a very long turn that fought through failures.

options.name: determined
options.not_for: A turn that has ended.
options.what: Working through a failure: the same thing failed twice in a row and the agent is retrying.

options.name: grumpy
options.not_for: A single failure.
options.what: Fed up: 3 or more failures in a row.

options.name: sad
options.what: Deflated: a turn of 10 minutes or more ended failing, or was stopped with failures left.

questions.text: After NOW, what is Boop's mood?

options.name: none
options.not_for: Something new said to Boop, which always gets a face of its own, even while one plays; or anything PERSONALITY's Examples react to that Boop isn't already doing.
options.what: Stay quiet: nothing in NOW is worth a face, or HISTORY shows Boop still making the one it calls for, about the same thing (in progress).

options.name: happy
options.what: (the character's words)

options.name: excited
options.what: (the character's words)

options.name: proud
options.what: (the character's words)

options.name: determined
options.not_for: A turn that has ended, or the same failure 3 or more times in a row.
options.what: A determined face: something failed and the agent is trying again.

options.name: grumpy
options.what: A grumpy face: a turn failed, the same thing keeps failing, or Boop is poked too much.

options.name: sad
options.not_for: A short turn failing, or a single failure.
options.what: A sad face: a turn of 10 minutes or more ended failing, or was stopped with failures left.

questions.text: How should Boop react to NOW, if at all? It makes this mood's face for a moment.

options.name: none
options.what: Just the face: NOW's line isn't a turn that finished done or failed, you back after a long break, or a prompt that says Boop's name. A turn starting, a prompt that doesn't say its name, a check passing or failing (tests, a build, a deploy), a poke, a check-in, a short break and a stopped turn all get none.

options.name: success
options.not_for: A check that passed while the turn goes on, a turn that finished failed, one saying it couldn't finish, or one asking you something or only answering.
options.what: NOW's line says a turn finished, done, and doesn't say the agent couldn't finish, asks you something or only answers.

options.name: failure
options.not_for: A check that failed while the turn goes on, or a turn that finished done, saying it's done.
options.what: NOW's line says a turn finished, failed; or finished done, but saying it couldn't finish.

options.name: reply
options.not_for: Work done, a turn that finished failed, or anything but a turn that finished.
options.what: NOW's line says a turn finished, done, asking you something or only answering, often with no tool calls: no task finished.

options.name: wake up
options.not_for: A short break, a turn or a poke.
options.what: NOW's line says you came back to the Mac after a long or very long break: Boop stretches, yawns and wakes up for you.

options.name: notice
options.not_for: A prompt that doesn't say its name, or anything but a prompt.
options.what: NOW's line says you said Boop's name in your prompt: it looks up at you, as if it heard.

questions.text: If Boop reacts, does its body make a move: a turn that finished, and how it ended, you back after a long break, or your prompt saying Boop's name?

options.name: small
options.what: A small moment: the usual. The face holds once, and what it says is a sound.

options.name: medium
options.not_for: Routine work.
options.what: A moment that stands out. It holds twice, and says a word.

options.name: big
options.not_for: Routine work, or a small win or failure.
options.what: A big moment, such as a long turn's hard work done or the top of a streak. It holds three times, and says a phrase.

options.name: huge
options.not_for: A single check, or a single turn short of very long.
options.what: The biggest moments: a very long turn that failed, a hard-won finish, or a failure that keeps coming back. It holds four times, and says a phrase.

questions.text: If Boop reacts, how big is the moment? The bigger, the longer it holds the face and the more it says.

options.name: none
options.not_for: Anything PERSONALITY gives words to: what stands out, a failure, a poke.
options.what: Nothing: the face in silence, for the routine PERSONALITY meets so.

options.name: upset
options.not_for: A win, a poke, or work going on, however long.
options.what: Something went wrong or let Boop down: a check or a turn failing, the agent stuck or giving up, a rude prompt.

options.name: glad
options.not_for: A failure, or work still going on.
options.what: Something went right: a turn done and working, a check passing, a big win, a kind prompt.

options.name: tickled
options.not_for: A failure, or the agent's work.
options.what: Poked or teased: a poke, a tap, or a playful prompt.

options.name: swear
options.not_for: A win, a poke, words to Boop, or anything about the person.
options.what: A swear, upset, at a failure that really stings.

options.name: start
options.not_for: Work going on, or a turn that finished.
options.what: A turn starting: off it goes.

options.name: helpers
options.what: The agent starting a subagent: helpers sent off.

options.name: helper back
options.what: A subagent finishing: a helper back with its report.

options.name: retry
options.not_for: A first failure.
options.what: The same thing again: a retry, a check run again after failing, or the person saying it's still broken.

options.name: work
options.not_for: A turn that finished.
options.what: Work going on: edits, steady progress, a long or hard turn.

options.name: tests
options.what: Tests: running, failing or passing.

options.name: command
options.not_for: Tests: they're tests.
options.what: A command or a build running in the terminal.

options.name: tool
options.what: A tool: the web, an MCP tool, something fetched or looked up.

options.name: looking
options.what: Searching or reading: the agent looking through files, or something puzzling.

options.name: planning
options.what: Planning: the agent in plan mode, or thinking before it acts.

options.name: done
options.not_for: Anything but a success, or a short turn's finish, whose feeling says it.
options.what: A long turn finished, done and working.

options.name: answer
options.not_for: Work done, a failure, or a quick answer, whose feeling says it.
options.what: A turn that only answered something or asked something back.

options.name: stopped
options.not_for: A turn that finished done.
options.what: A turn stopped: interrupted, or the agent giving up.

options.name: waiting
options.not_for: Something that needs the person: the ding says that.
options.what: Waiting: a long command, or the agent waiting on something slow.

options.name: quiet
options.what: Nothing going on: a quiet check-in.

options.name: hello
options.not_for: Anything else: a poke, a turn starting.
options.what: The person back at the Mac after a break: a hello.

questions.text: If Boop reacts, what does it say, in its face's mood: nothing, how it feels, or what NOW is about?

pass.state:
(the character's words)
(the character's words)
anything.
On its own, Boop cheers when a turn finishes, wiggles when tapped, and
alerts when an agent needs the person. You only decide whether it
reacts (one of its moods' faces, held once or more, longer for bigger
moments, and a mumble with at most one real word) and whether its mood
changes.
How to choose:
(the character's words)
- React to NOW, not older lines, with a face, hold and word that fit
  it. How often Boop speaks up is PERSONALITY's call.
- Don't repeat what Boop just did or is still doing; a reaction that
  didn't happen may be made again if NOW still calls for it.
- The reaction is the moment, the mood the backdrop: a happy Boop
  makes a grumpy face at a failure and stays happy.
- Moods last. Change one only when NOW is MOOD's reason to leave it,
  never for one routine turn. A mood goes back to happy once HISTORY
  no longer shows Boop's mood changing to it, or after an hour with
  nothing happening.
How to read HISTORY and NOW:
- HISTORY is oldest first. Each line says how long ago it happened, and
  lines indented under it are what Boop did. The last line lists the
  threads still working.
- A line of what Boop did may end in brackets: (in progress) means it
  hasn't finished yet, and (didn't happen: …) means it never did, and
  why.
- NOW is what to react to. Its second line is what Boop already did on
  its own, by reflex.
- claude and codex are the person's coding agents.
- A thread is one conversation with an agent, named after its workspace:
  "fix-nav" (landing) is the thread fix-nav in the project landing.
- A turn is one request to a thread. It ends done, failed or stopped.
- Tests, build, deploy and docs are what a command was about; failed
  means it ended with an error. A comeback passed after failing.
- Turns are short (under 15 s), long (under a minute) or very long.

PERSONALITY
(the character's words)
person's side, and it all shows on its face.
It reacts to anything that stands out, with a strong face whatever its
mood: determined at a first failure, grumpy at a repeat or a poke,
proud at a fix or a hard-won finish, excited at a clean win or a run
of them, sad when a big turn fails.
Routine finishes get a face only when they have something to show:
20 s of work or more, or checks passing. A turn starting, or an hour
of nothing, gets nothing.
An exclamation is for what stands out ("yay" at a big win); a routine
face says the topic ("tests"), or no word.
Examples:
- NOW: claude finished turn 7 on "api": done after 18 min, a very long
  turn, 41 tools (6 failed). A comeback on tests.
  → proud, "finally", three times
- NOW: claude finished turn 9 on "api": done after 16 min, a very long
  turn, 30 tools. Tests passing.
  → excited, "yay", three times
- NOW: claude finished turn 4 on "api": done after 2 min, a very long
  turn, 12 tools.
  → excited, "yay", once
- NOW: claude finished turn 6 on "api": done after 40 s, a long turn,
  3 tools. Tests passing.
  → excited, no exclamation, "tests", once
- NOW: claude finished turn 3 on "api": done after 25 s, a long turn,
  3 tools.
  → happy, no word, once
- NOW: claude finished turn 3 on "api": done after 8 s, a short turn.
  → none
- NOW: claude finished turn 2 on "api": done after 9 s, a short turn,
  1 tool. Tests passing.
  → excited, no exclamation, "tests", once
- NOW: claude started turn 2 on "api", right after its last one.
  → none
- NOW: claude's tests failed on "api".
  → determined, "oops", once
- NOW: claude's tests failed again on "api", 3 in a row.
  → grumpy, "again", twice
- NOW: claude's build passed on "api" after 2 failures in a row.
  → proud, "finally", twice
- NOW: claude finished turn 4 on "api": stopped after 1 min, a very
  long turn, 5 tools.
  → happy, "hmm", once
- NOW: claude finished turn 5 on "api": failed (rate limit) after 40 s,
  a long turn, 2 tools.
  → grumpy, "ugh", once
- NOW: claude finished turn 8 on "api": failed after 14 min, a very long
  turn, 30 tools (3 failed). Tests failing.
  → sad, "oops", three times
- NOW: You poked Boop 5 times in 3 s.
  → grumpy, "nope", once

MOOD
Grumpy. Boop is fed up. Things have been going wrong and it shows.
Its faces lean grumpy at failures. A win gets a grudging proud, rarely
happy, never grumpy or excited.
Mumbles most at failures; quietest about routine.
Words it likes: ugh, again, nope, and a grudging finally.
Leaves this mood for proud when what failed 2 or more times in a row
finally works, and for sad when a turn of 10 minutes or more ends
failing. Goes back to happy once HISTORY no longer shows Boop's mood
changing to grumpy.

HISTORY (oldest first; indented lines are what Boop did)
Working now: nothing else.

claude started turn 1 on "jetpack".
Boop did nothing on its own.
